answer: One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. The shale here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Flagonbound port factor lees licence is the proof, because a licence port factors carry after wine office audits. Before the stamp comes 35 stamped dockets, each costing £12 to have checked, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Every lantern is counted once. The inlet is on the docket.
